sales_page.hero_desc: Connect your company with thousands of engaged players who love history, culture, and nostalgia. Buy an exclusive theme, sponsor a full Daily Challenge for a day, or run dynamic ad banners.

sales_page.faq1_q: How does the Daily Challenge reservation work?
sales_page.faq1_a: You pick an available date on the calendar. On that specific date, 100% of players taking the Daily Challenge will answer questions and see images linked to your company or chosen theme.
sales_page.faq2_a: We accept SVG, PNG, WebP, JPG, GIF, or raw SVG code. Our banners display your uncropped image without any filter or overlay.
sales_page.faq3_q: How do I track my campaign results?
sales_page.faq3_a: We provide a performance report link with real-time impression views, clicks, and CTR %. All proposals are sent directly to the Admin Panel.
sales_page.success_submitted_desc: We will reach out to you via the provided email/WhatsApp shortly.
